verified_from_primary_sources.state_cartesian_representation: position_xyz plus Euler orientation as produced by FrankaRobot.get_robot_state
verified_from_primary_sources.action_dict_provenance: create_action_dict computes equivalent Cartesian and joint representations from the selected action space and current robot state

unresolved_or_not_present_in_rlds_schema: explicit per-episode declaration of the original selected action_space
formal reference-frame declaration in the published RLDS schema
formal units declaration attached to each RLDS feature
proof that no frames were dropped before RLDS conversion
exact semantics of step observation relative to command dispatch for every release version
known_schema_warning: The flattened action has shape 7 but is described as '[6x joint velocities, 1x gripper position]'; this is incompatible with a 7-joint Franka interpretation. The adapter forbids this field and uses explicitly named action_dict fields.

decoded_official_sample_audit.selection_rule: shard indices 6, 9, 19, and 29 were fixed before trajectory-value inspection to span early, middle, and late indices while keeping the pilot small
decoded_official_sample_audit.well_aligned_episode_pattern: five of six episodes have translation best lag 2; rotation and joint best lags are 1 or 2
decoded_official_sample_audit.unresolved_episode_pattern: one 50-step episode has ordinary command RMS but roughly one order lower measured-response RMS and near-zero command/response correlation in all three modalities
decoded_official_sample_audit.conclusion: zero-lag adjacency is falsified as a universal alignment rule; a single fixed release-wide lag is not yet justified

official_policy_transform_audit.policy_action_field: action_dict.cartesian_position converted to xyz plus 6D rotation plus gripper position
official_policy_transform_audit.policy_training_shift: robomimic_transform emits trajectory action index 1 onward
official_policy_transform_audit.dynamics_warning: imitation-learning label shift is not evidence of physical command-response timing

decision.adapter_code_status: synthetic_contract_tests plus decoded official multi-episode audit
decision.reason: Most audited episodes show a 1-2 frame response delay, while one episode shows no usable alignment in any motion modality. Without per-step timestamps and the episode's original selected action_space, these cases cannot be safely pooled as one command-to-response training distribution.
